content.short: Bitget Wallet provides asia's largest and one of the world's leading all-in-one Web3 trading wallets.
content.description: Bitget Wallet is a leading non-custodial crypto wallet that lets you trade, earn, pay, and explore Web3 from a single app. Launched in 2018 and formerly known as BitKeep, it now serves over 80 million users, making it one of the largest decentralized wallets globally. Supporting 130+ blockchains, Bitget Wallet provides advanced swap features, real-time market insights, staking, a smart DApp browser, and seamless crypto payments via in-app shop page, card, and QR code—delivering a simple, secure, and powerful Web3 experience.
content.meta: Bitget Wallet is a multi-chain wallet for trading, storing, and discovering Web3 assets. Discover Bitget Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
